_comment: WO-1359 action-bar face emblems. DERIVED from the sheet's own alpha bounding boxes (islands segmented on alpha>=8, then every face given the SAME box - max island size + 4px pad - centred on its own box, so all five render at one scale). Rects are NORMALIZED 0..1 in Unity texture space (origin BOTTOM-LEFT), so they survive any maxTextureSize downscale. Regenerate with Elarion/UI/Re-slice Action Bar Emblems after dropping a new sheet; the NAME ORDER below is the sheet's left-to-right reading order and is the ONLY thing to edit if a future sheet re-orders. The bar looks each face up BY NAME, never by index.
